description: The key owner's own alert delivery: only critical alerts, a daily or weekly digest instead of every signal, mute one alert type, turn a channel off. Pass only what the user asked for. Quiet hours: pass quiet_start_hour, quiet_end_hour (local) and quiet_timezone; if any is unknown set quiet_hours_requested and relay the question. Called with nothing, it returns a question listing the options.

critical_only.description: true to receive only critical alerts.

digest_hour.description: Hour of the daily digest, 0 to 23 UTC.

mute_types.description: Alert types to turn off: budget, cpa, ctr, roas, zero_conversions, overdue_reports, stale_campaigns.

quiet_end_hour.description: Quiet hours end, 0 to 23, local time.

quiet_hours_off.description: true to turn quiet hours off.

quiet_hours_requested.description: true when the user asks for quiet hours but did not give the hours or zone.

quiet_start_hour.description: Quiet hours start, 0 to 23, local time.

unmute_types.description: Alert types to turn back on.

name: notification_preferences_set
